As an experienced forklift driver, you will work for a specialist in the fruit and vegetable (AGF) sector. A cleanroom is a very clean and sterile working environment: designed to limit or, if possible, exclude contamination from the product process. The contamination may consist in dust or fibers, airborne microorganisms, fine dust or chemical vapors. The production of medicines and microelectronics, but also, for example, the cultivation of bacteria in Petri dishes, require a cleanroom environment to varying degrees.

In this position you work in a production/cleaning environment. Of course, you also test products. In addition, your daily work as a cleanroom process operator consists of:

- Cleaning high-tech parts (technical parts) following instructions and protocols.
- Perform assembly and cleaning work.
- Performing quality measurements.
- Working on the basis of instructions and drawings (Powerpoint).

To succeed in this role, it is preferable that you already have technical knowledge / technical experience in a cleanroom or any other production environment.

Are you experienced in a cleanroom environment and do you understand the importance of accuracy, quality, and discipline? Then this could be the next challenge you are looking for!

What are you going to do?
As a Cleanroom Operator, you will work in a modern ISO Grade 2 cleanroom where high-value, mainly metal components are cleaned, inspected, and packaged.

Your responsibilities include:

- Cleaning precision parts according to strict procedures
- Performing visual quality inspections using UV and blue inspection lights
- Operating cleaning installations and drying machines
- Vacuum packing cleaned products
- Inspecting components for contamination and damage
- Working according to cleanroom and quality standards
- Handling valuable high-tech components with great care

What do we offer?
- Starting salary of €15.92 gross per hour, excluding shift allowance
- With the 18% shift allowance, your hourly wage increases to €18.79 gross per hour
- You will work in a rotating two-shift schedule:
- One week Monday to Friday: 06:00 - 14:30
- Other week Monday to Thursday: 14:30 - 23:30 and Friday off
- Average working week of 38 hours
- Enjoy a long weekend every other week
- Extensive onboarding and training program of 3 to 4 months
- Personal guidance from experienced colleagues during your training period

Where will you work?
You will join a modern and professional working environment where quality, teamwork, and respect are key values. The atmosphere is informal and friendly, with colleagues supporting each other whenever needed. Because many international employees work at this location, English is the primary language on the shop floor.

In addition to a great workplace, employees enjoy excellent facilities, including a modern cafeteria with fresh fruit provided weekly, vending machines for snacks and drinks, and a separate relaxation area featuring a table football game. It is a pleasant environment where you can get to know your colleagues and unwind during break
